name: moment
title: Moment
description: Bounded, in-place reaction wrapper for a closed loop, capped at intensity 2. Gamification-exclusive: inert without data-game="on" (ADR-0001). Not included in the core bundle - install it only in a repository that has opted in.
docs: Intensity is capped at 2: intensity 3 (screen-level celebration, particle bursts, overlays) does not exist in this design system and must never become expressible through this component. Moment renders no icon or text of its own; the caller's children carry the actual state change, which is what still communicates closure when the animation is removed under reduced motion. See DESIGN.md.
